title: Can Make Arithmetic Progression From Sequence
summary: An arithmetic progression is defined by a constant difference between consecutive elements.
statement: An arithmetic progression is defined by a constant difference between consecutive elements. Given an array arr, determine if it can be reordered to meet this criterion. Return true if possible, otherwise false.
constraints: Return whether consecutive values can have one common difference.
hints: Require every later adjacent difference to equal it.
A sorted arithmetic progression has this property, and any rearrangeable progression sorts into exactly that order.
editorial: A sorted arithmetic progression has this property, and any rearrangeable progression sorts into exactly that order.

tests.explanation: Sorted values 1,3,5 have constant difference two.
Sorted differences one and two do not match.
